name: Project file lifecycle verifies project naming, autosave indicator, and file import/export
description: Verify drawing a solid colored ball, updating the project title in the top header, asserting the autosave badge indicates successful IndexedDB synchronization, opening the Export modal to inspect JSON structure, and verifying the Import flow.

planSteps.description: Select the Ellipse tool (press O), ensure shape mode in context bar is 'Shape: Filled Solid', press down on canvas, drag diagonally for at least 150 pixels, and release to draw a prominent circle
Select Flood Fill (press G), select an amber color, and click inside the circle to solidly color it
Click the project name input in the top header and type 'Hero Ball Artwork'
Verify the autosave status badge in the header shows 'Saved' indicating continuous background storage
Click the 'Export' button in the top header
Click the '.Pixibun' tab in the export modal
Verify the Project Export panel displays the project file name 'Hero Ball Artwork.pixibun' with JSON format specification
Click the 'Import' button in the top header
Verify the Import dialog appears with support for .pixibun project files, spritesheet images, and JSON animation descriptors
